name: PHC Holdings Corporation
summary: PHC Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare digital and precision technology solutions in Japan, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Diabetes Management, Healthcare Solutions, and Diagnostics & Life Sciences. It offers precision anatomical pathology for cancer, including tissue processors, digital pathology, and histology consumables; cell growth and preservation, such as CFC-free ultra-low temperature freezers, CO2 incubators, and live cell metabolic analyzer and cell expansion bioreactor system; and diagnostic testing comprising clinical testing, diagnostic reagents, and digital diabetes management solutions.…
